wa_faq_title: How WhatsApp Multi-Device Works & Safety Guidelines
wa_faq_1_q: Does my phone need to stay online?
wa_faq_1_a: With WhatsApp Multi-Device protocol, your phone does not need to remain continuously connected to the Internet once paired. However, WhatsApp requires you to open the app on your primary phone at least once every 14 days to keep linked devices active.
wa_faq_2_q: Can multiple managers reply at the same time?
wa_faq_2_a: Yes! All assigned operators in QoraCRM can communicate with clients simultaneously from the single WhatsApp number.
wa_faq_3_q: Is it safe from account bans?
wa_faq_3_a: QoraCRM uses official Multi-Device linked device handshakes for regular customer support. To keep your number safe, do not use it for mass cold spamming.

wa_privacy_notice: We do not store your chat messages or contacts on our servers. All conversations and customer data are stored exclusively in your own self-hosted WordPress database. Our gateway operates strictly as a secure real-time transit bridge.
wa_privacy_notice_short: Zero cloud storage: your chat history and contacts are never stored on external servers and remain 100% in your self-hosted WordPress database.
wa_faq_privacy_q: Are my chat messages and contacts stored on QoraCRM servers?
wa_faq_privacy_a: No, absolutely not. 100% of your chat history, contacts, and customer conversations are stored solely inside your own WordPress database. The QoraCRM WhatsApp Gateway functions strictly as an ephemeral transit proxy and never stores or logs your private chats or customer contact records.
